messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from RFC meeting: we need a pragmatic plan for service auth thats low-latency for hot paths but supports per-route least-privilege. brainstorming thread.

devin: two-mode idea: ambient service identity for default fast auth, and explicit per-request actor when caller needs to assert a different principal.

luke: ambient is great for perf but risky for transitive privilege. explicit actor gives better auditability.

sam: hybrid is reasonable. require an "X-Actor" header for impersonation and enforce stricter checks there.

maya: rollout thought: add route-level annotations (require_actor: true/false) and an enforcement toggle (observe/enforce).

anna: also add per-route cache_ttl so we can tune latency-sensitive endpoints separately.

devin: implementation: precompile route policies into bitmask rules at startup to keep per-request checks O(1).

luke: precompile implies policy versioning and atomic refreshes. need a metric when service policy != central policy (auth.policy.version).

sam: migration concern: API key schema change to include "claims" list and "kind". default map legacy keys to a legacy claim.

maya: agreement: schema change must be backward compatible and provide a migration tool.

devin: inter-environment calls: use short-lived STS exchange tokens rather than long-lived signed delegations. easier to revoke.

luke: edge: long-running jobs that start ambient then later do admin ops. runtime should require explicit actor before any privilege escalation.

anna: testing: add fault-injection for policy refresh failures and replay harness to catch transient cache staleness.

infra-bot: INFSEC-8123 created for canary rollout.

maya: action items: I'll draft an RFC addendum with phases and sample route YAML (observe -> cache -> enforce).

devin: I'll prototype precompile + in-memory bitmask PoC for perf benching.

luke: I'll spec the migration tool and dashboard queries for violations.

anna: I'll own runbook + emergency revocation steps. include metric auth.enforcement.violation_count.

maya: Thanks. Sync next Tue 11am. :thumbsup:
